brief:
A Palestinian prisoner died Wednesday in an Israeli detention facility, the Wafa news agency reported. The circumstances of the death were not immediately detailed in available reports.

In a separate incident, a youth was injured by Israeli gunfire during a raid in the West Bank. The details of the shooting and the extent of injuries remain unclear from current reporting.
dek: Palestinian prisoner dies in Israeli detention, youth injured by Israeli gunfire in West Bank raid A Palestinian prisoner died on Wednesday in an Israeli detention facility, Wafa news reported on Wednesday.
title: Palestinian prisoner dies in Israeli detention facility
